details: Changed series from Sep 29 22:00 to Oct 1 10:00; read-back day and time match.
Oct 8 moved to Oct 9; Oct 15 remains at 10:00.
Second page displays Reopen after first page marks event complete.
One batch saved as two dated occurrences in month view.
Calendar and activity records replace private titles; source names absent from rendered records.
Current-minute event becomes due, snoozes ten minutes, then acknowledgement clears inbox.
Offline date navigation suppresses wrong-day data; same-revision reconnection reloads target date.
Paused HTTP 200 response until client timeout, retained draft, reloaded, retried same operation, exactly one calendar event.
Named QA-only event deleted after confirm and remains absent after reload.
Chrome 390x844, 320x740 Chinese, and 1024x600 device layouts fit viewport; mobile editor checked. IAB screenshot emulation issue led to Chrome verification.
Stopped only owned API/Vite processes, started scripts/dev.sh, existing session and seven sample events persisted.
Replaced committed 200 response with test 500; same-operation retry preserves exactly one event.
Date fields use full rows on mobile; reminder checkbox intrinsic width fixed; one-week choice and cancel reachable without horizontal overflow.
